title: The Perfect Passive System
subtitle: amātus sum / eram / erō. Periphrastic forms with the participle.
objectives: Form perfect passive using participle + sum.
Form pluperfect passive using participle + eram.
Form future perfect passive using participle + erō.
Translate passive perfects with 'have been', 'had been', 'will have been'.

sections.heading: Perfect passive system
sections.body:
Perfect passive: amātus sum, amātus es, amātus est, amātī sumus, amātī estis, amātī sunt

Pluperfect passive: amātus eram, amātus erās, etc.

Future perfect passive: amātus erō, amātus eris, etc.

Caesar writes: oppidum captum est. — The town has been captured.

words.gloss: The town was captured by Caesar.
